<!-- pr-reviewer: 02ceecef5f79953be3d584ccbb27a44944d9010f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is the independent safety-floor review of the head.

What looks good:
- crates/cl/src/cl/path_approach.rs `seat_approach` moves only the start point of the opening rapid. It checks all four gates before it moves anything: finite target, a real first move, an exact match on the seed point, and a rapid that leaves the seed in X/Y. A path that opens on its own cut point is left as it is.
- crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs calls it once, before the yaw exit. The origin comes from posting::wcs_context, so it uses setup::wcs_slot. No second derivation exists on this path. The 3+2 case maps the origin into the plane first.
- No unwrap, expect or panic outside tests. No golden file changes. The decision file docs/decisions/2382-wcs-start.md is in the PR.

Results, built locally on the trial merge with main 983f527bd (clean):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| cargo test -p camcraft-cl --test origin_approach | 7 passed |
| cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wcs_start | 4 passed |
| cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib | 364 passed, 1 ignored |
| cargo test -p camcraft-cl --lib | 46 passed |
| cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl --all-targets -D warnings | pass |

Mutation check: with the seat call replaced by a world-origin no-op, `a_2d_operation_starts_over_the_wcs_origin` and `a_3d_operation_starts_over_the_wcs_origin` fail, and the hole-list pin stays green. The pins bite.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking, not from this PR):
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` fails on main's own line `crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128` (`.map(&resolve)`, needless borrow, clippy 1.99). It is present at main 983f527bd. This lane will file it so the post-merge gate stays honest.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
